_why: Every SECURITY DEFINER function in public that a logged-out visitor may EXECUTE. A definer function runs with its owner's privileges, so this list is the anonymous attack surface of the database and it should only ever shrink by accident. scripts/ci/check-anon-definer-grants.mjs compares the live grants to this file.
_measured: 2026-09-18. 2,571 SECURITY DEFINER functions in public; 35 were anon-executable, 772 authenticated-executable. 2 of the 2,571 leave search_path mutable and neither is anon-executable, so the exploitable combination is empty. Thirteen inert grants were revoked by migration 20260918121836.

_reasons.anon-policy: Named by an RLS policy that anon evaluates. A policy expression runs as the QUERYING role, so this grant is load-bearing: revoking it breaks anonymous reads of the table.
_reasons.invoker-view: Named by a security_invoker view that anon may SELECT, which evaluates as the caller for the same reason.
_reasons.public-read: A read deliberately offered to logged-out visitors - the signed-out marketing, SEO and sign-up surface.
_reasons.credential-read: A dedicated random receive credential is required before returning any private delivery metadata; a public API key alone grants no data.

allowed.note: A share link. The id is a random UUID minted only by the authenticated owner of a settled game, and the function returns that one immutable, explicitly shared prize snapshot. A logged-out caller learns nothing else: no identity, wallet, club detail, seed, unshared game, enumeration or write capability. The grant is deliberate and load-bearing - migration 20260919153418 makes it, asserts it, and raises if it is absent - and it is the same written decision already held in public.ca_browser_definer_allowlist and in the anonPublicSurface list of scripts/ci/definer-authorization.allowlist.json.

Short shared-hand replay link (smarter.poker/h/<token>). Takes an 8-char random token minted by the authenticated sender and returns only that explicitly shared hand snapshot, preview and invite code; malformed, missing or deleted-sender tokens return {found:false}, and revoked links return {found:true,revoked:true} with no hand payload. Deliberately granted to anon in migration 20261107021555 so signed-out visitors and link-preview crawlers can open shared hands. Since migration 20261126054024 (issue #9828) it is STABLE and writes nothing: p_count is accepted and ignored, and views are counted by fn_ca_shared_hand_count_view (authenticated and service_role only). Recorded in public.ca_browser_definer_allowlist, reviewedAnonReaders and anonPublicSurface in that change.

Aggregate tournament prize funding reader for lobby/rewards display (collected, overlay, gross_coverage, house_required, house_posted, house_due). STABLE read-only SQL that enforces the same private-event club-membership check as tournaments_select_scoped via auth.role() and auth.uid(), returning zero rows for private events to non-members and exposing no player identities, wallets or bank details. Deliberately granted to anon in migration 20261102051957 (updated 20261105222502).

Club tournament leaderboard read from the folded per-player totals table that a cron refresh maintains. STABLE read-only SQL returning, for one club, the same non-private per-player tournament totals (played, wins, final tables, ITM, prizes, buy-ins, biggest win, username) that anon already reads through fn_club_tournament_stats, which now calls it instead of re-aggregating every finished entry on each read. Private events are excluded at fold time; no wallets, balances or contact details. Deliberately granted to anon in migration 20261125022320.
